files.trips.json: four separate original Tripsy trip frames, NOT full raw import
files.accommodations.json: new booking-provider search quotes for actual dates/occupancy
files.fare_rules.json: operator fares and conditions with as_of
files.budget_scenarios.json: transparent unselected scenarios with integer cents
files.day_plans.json: option sets, no fixed clock itinerary

common_enums.travel_datetime: ISO-8601 plus IANA timezone; do not infer exact hour from date-only Tripsy plans

rules: Survey 0 is low interest, not hard veto
Search quote != confirmed checkout or booking
Alternative activities/lodgings excluded from booked budget
Prices based on exact party count and date; other variants require fresh searches
Precise map pins require verified coordinates
Every sourced fact carries source id or explicit unsourced status
